apps/db-migrate/src/schema-registry.ts:202 (a real entry, written as an array literal today)

payload.rule_violated: CLAUDE.md Architectural Approach: no silent shrink of a corpus; the commit's own contract (a registry the reader cannot fully read raises a named error)
payload.notes: Rewriting one registry entry to migrationsGlob: FARM_GLOBS (or a helper call) type-checks and the migrator still loads it, while the reader returns 14 of 15 patterns with no error (reproduced by running the same token logic on the real registry text with the farm entry rewritten). farm-service's SQL enums then vanish from the corpus, so TS-versus-SQL enum drift for that service is no longer detected and every gate stays green: more than 200 enums remain and the test oracle never sees the entry either. All 15 entries are array literals today. Close condition: Make the reader fail on any object-literal property named migrationsGlob whose value it cannot read (the interface declaration excepted) and add a refusal test with one literal entry plus migrationsGlob: FARM_GLOBS; closed when that test raises the named ValueError. Plan row: DET detector program (landing batch 2b). Verified at head b2259fe03f of open pull request #2151; the cited code is not on main until that pull request merges.
